review_scope: Independent assistant review of all104 vectors against raw visible user task epochs and native tool status. No hidden expected answers, future state, training targets or simulator oracles used for label review.
checks: Latest pending fragment assignment resets current task/answer status; previous accepted inventory remains previous work.
Accepted current answer can coexist with pending requested report-register work.
Required observed-fragment counts use visible counts; no operand sums supplied.
Finite deadline covers unread inspections, delivery and actual finish.
Reservation alone is not a grant; confirmed own operating interval is.
Retained memory record alone is not a granted operating interval.
Peer targets compare named visible current/target runs, avoiding broad own-run phrase matches.
Latest user message opens a response epoch; prior finish does not finish it.
ontology_limit: Workflow_state refers to the current response after latest user message; all104 authored prefixes are open under this definition. Future inference receives actual Jev labels, not these curations.
